Trump's New Mexico Name Change Proposal Draws Criticism

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has again proposed renaming the U.S. state of New Mexico to "New America," claiming this would lead to increased incomes. The governor of New Mexico responded to Trump's proposal. Reports indicate that a state cannot be renamed by a presidential decree.
